title: Particle Physics
subtitle: Particle Physics with model-based reasoning, equations, and exam application.
concept: Particle Physics uses physical models and measurable quantities to explain and predict system behavior.
Nuclear structure is described with nucleons and binding effects.
Radioactive decay is random for nuclei but predictable for large samples.
